Subscription Plans

The company offers three subscription plans: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise.

The Basic Plan is suitable for individual users.

The Pro Plan is designed for professionals and small businesses.

The Enterprise Plan is intended for large organizations requiring advanced features and support.

Customers may upgrade or downgrade their plans at any time.

Warranty Policy

All physical products include a one-year limited warranty.

The warranty covers manufacturing defects and hardware failures under normal usage conditions.

The warranty does not cover accidental damage, misuse, or unauthorized modifications.

Customers must provide proof of purchase when requesting warranty service.

Warranty claims are reviewed within 7 business days.

Payment Methods

The company accepts major credit cards including Visa, MasterCard, and American Express.

Payments can also be made using PayPal.

Enterprise customers may request invoice-based payments.

All transactions are secured using industry-standard encryption.

Payment confirmations are sent automatically via email.
